research_notes: The future safety margin should account for both close-overhead upper tail and task-tail uncertainty.
A soft cutoff can absorb task-tail uncertainty while hard-cap reserve protects the final checkpoint.
If unit-duration estimates become accurate, P3 may reduce the task-tail component of the margin.
If estimates are poor, P2's bounded-unit rule is more robust.
These are empirical tradeoffs rather than reasons to choose the most sophisticated policy by default.
The current boundary data will constrain all of them.
